Who We Are
 We drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.
We are looking for a SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management Developer with strong technical expertise in SAP Transportation Management (TM) to join our Custom Development team.
The role focuses on high-quality, future-proof development in SAP TM, covering transportation planning, freight execution, charge calculation, carrier integration, and complex logistics processes within SAP S/4HANA.
You will work in an international setup, closely collaborating with onshore architects, functional TM consultants, and customers.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design, develop, and maintain custom developments in SAP TM across S/4HANA landscapes
Implement TM-specific enhancements using: BAdIs, Enhancement Spots, PPF Actions
Freight Order and Freight Unit extensibility concepts
Business Object Processing Framework (BOPF) where applicable
Develop and adapt technical solutions aligned with standard TM business processes and customizing
Analyze functional and technical requirements in collaboration with TM functional consultants
Ensure high code quality, performance, and long-term maintainability of TM developments
Support technical design, code reviews, testing, and defect analysis
Participate in implementation phases including testing, go-live, and hypercare support
Act as a senior technical counterpart for onshore TM teams
Share knowledge and support junior developers as a technical coach
Participate in technical discussions and solution design sessions in English
 What You'll Bring Along
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA ABAP development
Solid experience as an SAP TM Developer
Strong expertise in: SAP TM development and enhancements, ABAP development in SAP TM context, TM BAdIs and enhancement framework, Freight Order, Freight Unit, Freight Booking, and Transportation
Requirement processing
TM integration technologies and interfaces
Solid understanding of SAP TM transportation processes and system customizing
Proven ability to translate functional TM requirements into technical solutions
Experience working in SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management projects
Good understanding of: Transportation Planning, Freight Execution, Charge Management, Carrier Collaboration, Event Management and Tracking scenarios
Experience with: Eclipse / ABAP Development Tools (ADT), CDS Views, OData Services, APIs and integration technologies, TM technical extensibility concepts, BOPF framework
Experience with SAP Clean Core principles and modern S/4HANA development approaches is a plus
Experience in international project setups is a plus
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Structured, quality-oriented, and responsible working style
Strong communication skills
